sections.title: What's stored
sections.body: The email you sign in with, the name you chose, a profile photo if you added one, and status photos, which are deleted after 24 hours. Also your home's tasks, shopping and events, and your choices in Settings. If you turned on notifications, an identifier for your device so they can reach it.

sections.title: Who sees it
sections.body: Only the people you live with in Homie. Your profile photo sits at an address that can't be guessed, and status photos only inside the home. We don't sell or share anything, and there are no ads or tracking in the app.

sections.title: Where it's kept
sections.body: Data is kept in Supabase (database and photo storage), the site runs on Vercel, notifications go through Apple, and the sign-in code is sent by email through Gmail.

sections.title: Deleting
sections.body: You can delete your account anytime, in Settings under Account. Your account, photos and device identifiers are deleted for good. What's in the home stays with whoever lives there; if no one else does, the home is deleted with everything in it.

install.title: Homie on your Home Screen

today.title: This is where the day starts
today.body: See what's waiting today, and tick a task off when it's done. Pick a day in the week to see its tasks and events.

tasks.title: Everything in one place
tasks.body: The household's tasks live here. Check one off when it's done, or add a new one with the plus button.

shopping.title: One list for both of you
shopping.body: Write what to buy, check off what's in the basket, and clear the bought items when you're home.

calendar.title: The household calendar
calendar.body: Pick a date to see that day, and add an event with anything you need to prepare.

settings.title: Your home
settings.body: See who's here, invite the other parent, and change the language and appearance.
